name: Gai lan (Chinese broccoli)

schedule.notes: Cut 8-in tops with thick stems, leaves, and small flower buds. Side shoots keep coming for weeks.

harvest.cues: Stems thick (1/2 in+), 8 to 12 in tall, with some leaves and tight flower buds. Few open white flowers are fine.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 5 to 7 days. Cooks in 2 to 3 minutes — quick stir-fry or oyster sauce.

varieties.name: Green Lance
varieties.notes: Tender stems, deep blue-green leaves. Fast to maturity.

varieties.name: White-Flowered Kailaan
varieties.notes: Larger plants. Slower but more productive over the season.

notes: Tender stems are the prize — peel any tough lower section. Goes with everything: oyster sauce, garlic, fermented bean. Cool-season standby; bolts hot.
